name: profanity_guard
label: Profanity Guard
description: Profanity Guard detects, highlights, redacts, rates, or rejects profane words and phonetic/obfuscated variants across text and JSON inputs.

user_properties.label: Filter Action
user_properties.description: Action on profanity match: 'highlight' wraps matches, 'redact' masks matches, 'reject' fails execution, 'flag_only' only rates in metadata.

user_properties.label: Tenant / User Profane Words
user_properties.description: Tenant-defined comma-separated profane words to extend the system list.

user_properties.label: Tenant / User Profanity Patterns
user_properties.description: Tenant-defined regex patterns (comma or newline-separated) for custom or phonetic profanity.

user_properties.label: Highlight Format
user_properties.description: Template used to highlight matched words when action is 'highlight'. Use {word} as placeholder.

user_properties.label: Redaction Replacement
user_properties.description: Replacement string used when action is 'redact'.

system_properties.label: System Strong Profane Words
system_properties.default: fuck, motherfucker, shit, asshole, bitch, cunt, bastard, dick, pussy, cock, whore, slut, sex, porn, cuck, SIS
system_properties.description: System-level strong profane words (comma-separated). Edit here without code changes.

system_properties.label: System Mild Profane Words
system_properties.default: piss, damn, hell, stupid, idiot, crap, ass, moron, dumb, jerk
system_properties.description: System-level mild profane words (comma-separated). Edit here without code changes.

system_properties.label: System Phonetic & Obfuscation Patterns
system_properties.description: System-level regex patterns for phonetic and symbol-obfuscated profanity.
